llm.summary: The skill is a coherent Upbit auto-trader: its code, instructions, and required local config (config.json with Upbit API keys) match the description and there are no unusual install or exfiltration patterns in the provided files.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim an Upbit auto-trader and the code implements monitoring, event processing, risk checks, order execution and an Upbit client. The only external runtime requirement is node and the skill expects API keys in a local config.json — this is proportionate to an auto-trader.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and README instruct running node commands (monitor_once/worker_once/smoke_test), reading ./config.json, and writing resource files under the skill's resources/ directory. The runtime instructions do not instruct reading unrelated system files or sending data to unexpected endpoints. They clearly describe files the skill writes and the expected cron setup.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No remote download/install spec is present; code is included and the README advises npm install/npm ci which pulls standard npm packages (axios, jsonwebtoken, uuid). The package.json/lockfile reference known registries; no high-risk external URLs or archive extracts are used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill expects Upbit accessKey/secretKey supplied via a local config.json (config.example.json shows required fields). Registry metadata shows no required env vars or primary credential — this is not dangerous but is a metadata omission the user should notice: API credentials are still required (in config.json). No other unrelated credentials or environment paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and model invocation defaults are normal. The skill persists state only under its own resources/ directory and uses local file locks to avoid overlapping cron runs. It does not request system-wide config changes or other skills' secrets.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent for an Upbit auto-trader, but it will perform real trades if you put live API keys in config.json and run with dryRun:false. Before installing: 1) Do not commit config.json (it is in .gitignore). 2) Prefer creating Upbit keys with minimal permissions (disable withdrawals if possible) and test with dryRun:true or small amounts. 3) Run node skill.js smoke_test locally to verify API access and behavior. 4) Review the UpbitClient and orderService code (shipping in this bundle) yourself if you need stricter assurance — those modules perform authenticated requests and order placement. 5) Adjust the cron command paths (the examples use a user-specific absolute path) to your environment and run the skill in an isolated session. 6) Audit installed npm dependencies (npm audit) and keep keys rotated and stored securely. If you want the registry metadata to reflect required credentials, ask the publisher to declare the Upbit API key requirement explicitly.
